shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/; git status --short | head -20

cat AGENTS.md && echo ---- && find src -type f | head -50 && echo ---- && cat src/* 2>/dev/null | head -150; echo ----; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'
rg -n -C 4 -i "dashboard|dashkit|grid|drag" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150

npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -60; echo ----; npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -30; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -40

npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit@10.5.2 @gravity-ui/icons@^2.13.0 2>&1 | tail -15; echo ----; node -e 'for (const p of ["dashkit","icons","uikit"]) console.log(p, require("./node_modules/@gravity-ui/"+p+"/package.json").version)'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs 2>/dev/null
git diff package.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -300; echo; wc -l node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md
sed -n 300,536p node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit && grep -n -i -A12 "required setup\|## Install\|css" README.md | head -80; echo ----; cat package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types|typings|exports|style)"' ; ls build | head -40; echo ----; cat build/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80
sed -n 19,80p README.md; echo ----; cat build/esm/index.d.ts; echo ----; grep -rn "css" build/esm/index.js | head -5; ls build/esm | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && cat components/index.d.ts; cat plugins/index.d.ts; echo ----; cat components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo ----; ls components; echo ----; ls plugins; cat plugins/*/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ----; cat shared/types/index.d.ts | head -20; ls shared/types

cat shared/types/plugin.d.ts; echo ----; cat shared/types/config.d.ts | head -80; echo ----; cat components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.d.ts; echo ----; cat components/ActionPanel/types.d.ts; echo ----; grep -rln "\.css'\|\.css\"\|css" --include=*.js . | head -5; grep -rn "import.*\.css" --include=*.js . | head -5

grep -rn "react-grid-layout" --include=*.js . | head -5; cat plugins/Text/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat plugins/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls plugins/Text; echo ----; sed -n 1,80p components/index.d.ts >/dev/null; cat typings/plugin.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120; ls typings

grep -rln "react-grid-item\|react-resizable-handle" . | head; grep -rn "react-grid-item" --include=*.css . | head -3; echo ----; cat typings/common.d.ts | head -80; echo ----; cat typings/global.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; cat ../../../../../node_modules/react-grid-layout/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'; ls ../../../../react-grid-layout/css 2>/dev/null

sed -n 1,70p components/GridItem/GridItem.css; echo ----; grep -n "react-grid\|position" components/DashKitView/DashKitView.css | head; echo ----; grep -rn "react-grid-layout/css\|react-resizable/css" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/ --include=*.md --include=*.js -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v test | head -3; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules | grep -i "react-resizable\|react-draggable\|react-grid"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Card Progress Switch Button Text Label Flex Lang configure ThemeProvider 2>&1 | head -60; echo ----; grep -rn "cols" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/*.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/constants/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo ----; grep -n "apiHandler\|getMarkdown" -A4 node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Text/Text.js | head -40; grep -n '"version"' node_modules/react-resizable/package.json

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Card Progress Switch Button Text Label Flex Lang configure 2>&1 | head -60; echo ----; grep -rn "cols" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/GridLayout.js | head -5; grep -rn "cols\|rowHeight" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/constants/*.js | head -5; echo ----; grep -n "Required setup\|ThemeProvider\|import" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls build | head -30; cat build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; find build -name "Card.d.ts" -o -name "Progress.d.ts" -o -name "Switch.d.ts" | head; sed -n 90,110p README.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/Card/Card.d.ts; echo ----; cat components/Progress/Progress.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; cat components/Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -50; echo ----; cat components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; cat components/Label/Label.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; cat utils/configure.d.ts | head -30

cat components/Progress/types.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; grep -n "variant" components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "'header-\|display-\|body-1\|subheader-" components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -8; echo ----; cat components/Button/Button.d.ts | grep -n "view\|size" | head -8; echo ----; cat components/types.d.ts | grep -n "ControlProps" -A12 | head -30; echo ----; cat components/Flex/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls components | tr '\n' ' '

grep -n "ButtonView =" -A3 components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -8; cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && cat plugins/Title/types.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; cat components/GridLayout/GridLayout.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -n "isMobile\|defaultLayout" components/DashKit/DashKit.js | head -12; echo ----; grep -n "w: \|h: \|cols" constants/*.js | head -10

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && grep -rn "BUTTON_VIEWS = " uikit/build/esm/components/Button/*.js | head -2; grep -rn "cols: \|cols:" dashkit/build/esm --include=*.js | grep -v test | head -5; grep -rn "rowHeight" dashkit/build/esm --include=*.js | grep -v test | grep -v "this.props" | head -5; grep -rn "compactType" dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.js | head -3

sed -n 1,12p uikit/build/esm/components/Button/constants.js; echo ----; sed -n 5,30p dashkit/build/esm/utils/register-manager.js; echo ----; grep -n "isMobile" -r dashkit/build/esm --include=*.js | grep -v test | head -5; echo ----; grep -rn "defaultProps\|static defaultProps" dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.js | head -3; grep -n "onChange" dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.js | head -10

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html; echo ----; grep -n "setSettings" -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/utils/register-manager.js | head -30; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/i18n; ls node_modules/@types | tr '\n' ' '; echo; ls node_modules/react-grid-layout | head; echo ----; grep -n "style\|className" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/

grep -o "\-\-g-spacing-[0-9]*" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/*.css 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles; grep -n "gap\|alignItems\|justifyContent" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -6; grep -n "BoxProps" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head -12; cat .gitignore; grep -n "\-\-g-color-text-secondary\|--g-color-base-background:" -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/*.css | head -3

sed -n 28,36p node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/utils/register-manager.js; sed -n 49,70p node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/utils/register-manager.js; grep -n "registerPlugins\|reloadPlugins" -A6 node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.js | head -24; npm install react-grid-layout@^1.5.4 react-resizable@^3.2.0 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -3; ls node_modules/react-grid-layout/css node_modules/react-resizable/css
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -60; echo "exit=$?"

npx tsc --noEmit >/tmp/tsc.log 2>&1; echo "tsc exit=$?"; grep -v "npm warn" /tmp/tsc.log | head -30; npx vite build --outDir /tmp/dash-dist --emptyOutDir 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -15; echo "vite exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit >/tmp/tsc.log 2>&1; echo "tsc exit=$?"; grep -v "npm warn" /tmp/tsc.log | head -30; npx vite build --outDir /tmp/dash-dist --emptyOutDir >/tmp/vite.log 2>&1; echo "vite exit=$?"; grep -v "npm warn" /tmp/vite.log | tail -4; echo ----; git diff package.json; grep -n '"node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit"' -A2 package-lock.json | head -4
